reason: Closes the page from a locator handler with page.close({ reason: 'custom reason' }), and expects the click the handler interrupted to fail with that reason in its message; Strider's page.close has no reason option, so its closed-page failure can't say it
Reading a popup's opener(), which must be null once the opener has closed; Strider's Popup has no link back to the opener
Exposing a function to the page, which the page calls to close the page from its own script; Strider has no exposeFunction

decision: Sent-header waits end with their owner
reason: Expects `request.allHeaders()` to reject when the page closes before the sent headers are known. Strider's `headersSent` has no failure but a timeout: when the page closes it gives the available sent headers, or the request event's headers, so it succeeds. The response half of the test passes
Waiting for a response's body to finish, which must reject when the page closes; Strider's NetworkResponse has no finished
